abilities.name: cursed-body
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of Disabling any move that hits the Pokémon.

kanto.flavorText: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be GENGAR’s doing.

original-johto.flavorText: Hiding in people's shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.

hoenn.flavorText: Deep in the night, your shadow cast by a streetlight may suddenly overtake you. It is actually a GENGAR running past you, pretending to be your shadow.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Lurking in the shadowy corners of rooms, it awaits chances to steal its prey’s life force.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a GENGAR delighting in casting curses on people.

updated-johto.flavorText: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey’s shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

original-unova.flavorText: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.

updated-unova.flavorText: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.

kalos.flavorText: Hiding in people’s shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Sometimes, on a dark night, your shadow thrown by a streetlight will suddenly and startlingly overtake you. It is actually a Gengar running past you, pretending to be your shadow.

original-alola.flavorText: It apparently wishes for a traveling companion. Since it was once human itself, it tries to create one by taking the lives of other humans.

updated-alola.flavorText: Even your home isn’t safe. Gengar will lurk in whatever dark corner of a room it can find and wait for its chance to catch its prey.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: A Gengar is close by if you feel a sudden chill. It may be trying to lay a curse on you.

swsh.flavorText: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.

pla.flavorText: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!
